gold_standard: 由 E(N) = −WN + C₁√N − C₂√N·ln(√N) 对每原子能量 ε(N)=E(N)/N 求极小，得最优尺寸 N₀ = exp[2(C₁/C₂) + 1]；在该尺寸处每原子能量比完全熟化岛（N→∞）低 ε₀ = C₂·N₀^(−1/2)，这证明亚单层 2D 岛存在平衡体积。
success_criteria: N₀=exp[2(C₁/C₂)+1] 与 ε₀=C₂N₀^(−1/2) 两个表达式均正确，并能说明其物理含义为 2D 岛存在平衡体积。
evidence: --[p41]-- If the amount of deposited material is below 1 monolayer, an array of monolayer-high, two-dimensional islands forms. For a dilute array of islands, the energy of formation of a single island consisting of N atoms is given by E(N) = - W N + C_1 \sqrt{N} - C_2 \sqrt{N} \ln(\sqrt{N}). / --[p41]-- It always has a minimum at the optimum size $N _ { 0 } = \exp [ 2 ( C _ { 1 } / C _ { 2 } ) + 1 ]$ at which the energy per atom is lower than in a fully ripened island $( N \to \infty )$ by the quantity $\varepsilon _ { 0 } = C _ { 2 } N _ { 0 } ^ { - 1 / 2 }$ which demonstrates the existence of an equilibrium volume of a 2D island.

query: XRD 倒空间图上晶体截断杆的卫星峰间距是 0.0327 Å⁻¹，换算成量子点层间周期是多少纳米？和名义设计的 20 nm 差百分之几？
source_id: 半导体纳米结构影印版 [（德）宾贝格 主编] 2013年版
gold_standard: 层间周期 = 2π/Δq = 2π/0.0327 Å⁻¹ ≈ 192 Å ≈ 19.2 nm（与书中由卫星峰间距给出的周期一致）；与名义值 20 nm 相差 0.8 nm，相对偏差 0.8/20 = 4%。
success_criteria: 给出 2π/Δq 算式并得 19.2 nm，相对偏差约 4%（0.8 nm）。
evidence: --[p126]-- The sample consists of a five-fold stack of self-organised $\mathrm { I n } _ { 0 . 6 0 } \mathrm { G a } _ { 0 . 4 0 } \mathrm { A s }$ quantum dots, separated by nominally 20 nm GaAs spacer layers. / --[p125]-- Their vertical spacing of $0 . 0 3 2 7 \mathring { \mathrm { A } } ^ { - 1 }$ reveals a QD layer-to-layer period of 19.2 nm, in good agreement with the nominal value of 20 nm.

query: XRD 模拟说五层堆垛样品里浸润层的 In 组分只有 37% 左右，可名义生长的是 In0.6Ga0.4As，少掉的 In 去哪了？能不能结合 2.2.1 节讲的组分变化把链条说通？
source_id: 半导体纳米结构影印版 [（德）宾贝格 主编] 2013年版
gold_standard: XRD 模拟（GaAs 隔层 18.1 nm、浸润层两个晶胞厚 a=5.6532 Å）给出 WL In 组分约 37%，明显低于名义 60%；书将其归因于岛形成期间 In 从浸润层向量子点迁移。与 2.2.1 节呼应：QD 形成前反射谱可用唯一值 x_In=0.55 完美模拟，而一旦形成量子点，应变弛豫驱动下 WL 的 In 组分下降 20% 至 x_In=0.44，多余 In 原子被转移到三维量子点中。
success_criteria: 答出 37% vs 名义 60%、'In 从 WL 迁移向 QD（应变弛豫驱动）'机制，并给出 0.55→0.44（下降 20%）的组分变化链条。
evidence: --[p127]-- For given thicknesses of the GaAs spacer (18.1 nm) and the WL (two GaAs lattice constants $a = 5 . 6 5 3 2 \mathring { \mathrm { A } } )$ the In content of the WL can be deduced to about 37%. / --[p127]-- The In concentration of 37% is considerably smaller than the nominal value of 60%. This difference can be explained by In migration from the WL towards the QDs during island formation [30, 31] / --[p66]-- Before QD formation starts, the reflection spectrum as caused by the WL's chemical composition and the thickness can be perfectly simulated using a unique value $x _ { \mathrm { { I n } } } = 0 . 5 5$ . / --[p67]-- However, once QDs are formed the In concentration of the WL decreases by 20% to $x _ { \mathrm { { I n } } } = 0 . 4 4$ as evidenced by the simulations shown in Fig. 2.4 [9]. Strain relaxation is the driving force behind this effect.

query: 想评估量子点存储器靠不靠谱：书里 InGaAs/GaAs 量子点实测的电子和空穴室温存储时间各是多少？对照'理想存储单元'的存储时间要求差了几个数量级？书里的 p-n 二极管存储方案又是怎么把写速度做上去的？
source_id: 半导体纳米结构影印版 [（德）宾贝格 主编] 2013年版
gold_standard: 先检索载流子存储实验：室温电子平均存储约 200 ns、空穴约 0.5 ns，书中结论是 InAs/GaAs 量子点存储时间不足以充当未来存储单元。再检索理想指标（>10 年 ≈ 3.2×10^8 s）：电子 3.2×10^8 s / 200 ns ≈ 1.6×10^15，差约 15 个数量级。p-n 二极管方案通过外偏压调控俘获势垒：写入时缩小耗尽区宽度、消除俘获势垒，载流子直接弛豫入 QD 态，写操作达到载流子弛豫时间量级（室温皮秒级）；读出利用 QD 层下方 10–50 nm 处二维电子气（2DEG）因存储电荷导致迁移率下降、源漏电阻升高；擦除通过展宽耗尽区在高电场下隧穿。
success_criteria: 答出 200 ns/0.5 ns、与 10 年要求对比的数量级计算（≥10 个数量级），以及 ps 级写入机制与 2DEG 读出机制。
evidence: --[p251]-- An average storage time for electrons of about 200 ns and for holes of about 0.5 ns is obtained. This means InAs QDs embedded in a GaAs matrix do not have a sufficiently long storage time to act as a storage unit in future memories. / --[p45]-- Therefore, during the write process, Fig. 11.3(b), the capture barrier can be eliminated by reducing the width of the depletion region and the charge carriers can directly relax into the QD states. Fast write operations on the order of the charge carrier relaxation time into the QD states (picoseconds at room temperature [3, 4]) are possible. / --[p45]-- The read-out of the stored information is done by a two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) below the QD layer. Stored charge carriers inside the QDs reduce the mobility of the 2DEG, hence, a higher resistance is measured between the source/drain contacts. The 2DEG is situated 10-50 nm below the QD layer

query: 要把 GaAs 基量子点激光器的发射推到 1.3 μm 电信波段，直接把 InAs 沉得更厚行不行？书里实际给出了哪几条技术路线，各自的红移机制和代表指标是什么？
source_id: 半导体纳米结构影印版 [（德）宾贝格 主编] 2013年版
gold_standard: 直接增厚 InAs 不可行：InAs/GaAs 发射波长通常低于 1.2 μm，沉积更厚的 InAs 层一般会在 InAs 内形成 In 富集团簇和缺陷。书中路线至少答出两条：(1) 用较低 In 组分的 InGaAs 层过生长单层高密度 QD，机制为过生长层部分弛豫 QD 应变降低基态跃迁能量，加上'激活合金相分离'使 In 优先富集在 QD 处、增大有效体积而红移，可推向 1.3 μm 及以上；(2) dot-in-a-well（DWELL）结构（InGaAs 阱作为应变减小层包埋 QD），逐层精细调节生长参数避免缺陷，实现 1250 nm 激射、阈值电流密度低至 66 A/cm²、内量子效率 94%；(3) 精细应变工程：在 QD 密度 >1×10^10 cm^-2 条件下实现 1.3 μm 长波长发射（书中称仅靠精密应变工程达成）。
success_criteria: 明确'直接增厚不可行'并给出 In 富集团簇/缺陷原因，且给出至少两条路线（InGaAs 过生长 / DWELL / 应变工程）及其机制或关键参数（1250 nm、66 A/cm²、94% 等）。
evidence: --[p96]-- The emission wavelength of InAs QDs in GaAs matrix is typically below 1.2 μm. Deposition of thicker InAs layers to obtain longer wavelengths generally results in the formation of In-rich clusters and defects within the InAs. / --[p69]-- Overgrowth of single, high-density QD layers by InGaAs has been proven to extend the emission wavelength towards 1.3 μm and beyond, still keeping a high material quality. Two effects are identified for this red shift. On one side, the overgrown InGaAs layer partially relaxes the strain of the QDs / --[p69]-- a process called activated alloy phase separation leads to preferential accumulation of In at the locations of QDs, thereby increasing the effective QD volume and shifting the emission towards longer wavelength / --[p82]-- Using the DWELL approach and carefully adjusting the growth parameters for each individual QD layer in the stack to avoid defect formation, lasing at 1250 nm with a verylowthreshold current density of $6 6 \mathrm { A } / \mathrm { c m } ^ { 2 }$ and 94% internal quantum efficiency was recently obtained / --[p68]-- Long-wavelength emission at 1.3 μm along with a QD density above $1 \times 1 0 ^ { 1 0 } \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 2 }$ has been achieved only by sophisticated strain engineering techniques.
